Documented examples for the `claude-code` connector (F16-R4), copied 2026-09-24.

- `.mcp.json`: the union of two literal examples on https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp — the
  project file `{"mcpServers": {"shared-server": {"type": "http", "url": ...}}}` and the
  environment-expansion example `"headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer ${API_KEY}"}`.
- `commands.txt`: the literal header example on the same page.
